note: The budgets of BENCHMARKS.md. run.py --budgets measures them; --record writes 'measured'. ciThreshold: what CI fails above, in the unit CI measures (tokens; instructions under callgrind). 'pending' needs a Linux callgrind run to be set; null has its reason in ciReason. A missed token budget's ciThreshold is its recorded value (a ratchet); a met one's is its target.

targets.ciReason: An idle second is wall clock by nature: callgrind counts instructions, not the time a thread sleeps.

targets.budget: A full frame: 1 ms at most
targets.ciReason: The frames are measured as the main thread's CPU time in CI, not under callgrind (software OpenGL makes it too slow).

targets.budget: One state change: 1 ms at most at any size, a 50,000-panel screen included
A revision applied and reconciled: 2 ms at most
Typing in a 100,000-line file: 8 ms at most from key to frame, at p99
targets.ciReason: A percentile of wall-clock samples: callgrind counts the step's instructions, not a percentile; the step's own count is locked by compare.py as editor/type-100k.

targets.budget: Scrolling a 1,000,000-line file at 120 Hz (8.33 ms a frame at p99)
targets.ciReason: A percentile of wall-clock samples: callgrind counts the step's instructions, not a percentile; the step's own count is locked by compare.py as editor/scroll-1m.

targets.budget: Opening a 50 MB file: 1 s at most
Opening a 50 MB file: memory at most 1.5 times the file plus 50 MB
Forge cold start to interactive: 300 ms at most
Forge with 10 tabs and a terminal: 150 MB at most
Quick open over 100,000 files: 30 ms at most per keystroke
Expanding a 100,000-node tree: 4 ms at most
A template's outline: 600 tokens at most
targets.ciReason: Missed: the threshold is the value recorded, so CI fails on growth while the target stays a miss.

targets.budget: A typical edit: 40 output tokens at most (the median canonical edit)
A re-read after one commit: 150 tokens at most
The format guide: 1,500 tokens at most per topic
targets.ciReason: Missed: the threshold is the value recorded, so CI fails on growth while the target stays a miss.

targets.budget: A whole feature request: 2,000 output tokens at most (the oracle's feature tasks)
